evidence.quote:
We verified the calibration against the June reference plates and it
holds across the full observing band.

observations.why: The 'we' enacts communal-sharing (collective body performing verification), while 'verified against' invokes authority-ranking (reference plates as external standard the result is held to). The communal-sharing 'we' is the more directly performed model; authority-ranking is secondary but present in the deference to a reference standard.
